title: Express res.json adds a WEAK content-hash ETag (and can answer 304 on a matching If-None-Match) on every API JSON response that does not set its own ETag; only the join-rules router now opts out
area: apps/api (all routers using res.json); apps/api/src/join-rules/router.ts sendJson
evidence: Found while implementing the join-rules ETag: GET /calendar/join-rules with no rule set stored returned ETag: W/"7e-..." generated by Express, contradicting 'no ETag when none is stored'; fixed for join-rules by sending JSON through res.end (sendJson). Other routes keep the Express default.
fix_direction: Nothing required for correctness today. If a later unit gives another resource a strong validator, give it the same treatment, or set the app-level 'etag' setting deliberately.
